summary: The filing is an 8-K by GS Mortgage Securities Corporation II as registrant for GS Mortgage Securities Trust 2016-GS4, reporting that Trimont LLC was removed as special servicer of the 540 West Madison Mortgage Loan (which constitutes approximately 7.3% of the asset pool) and Green Loan Services LLC was appointed as successor special servicer under the pooling and servicing agreement. This is a routine servicing change for a commercial mortgage-backed security. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, management change, deal termination, or SPAC event is present. Conservatively classified as not a special situation.
